videos.description: UMAR IGNORED SONG YADONG 😳 But Khabib Did This After the KO! 🔥 Umar Nurmagomedov ignored Song Yadong, but Khabib Nurmagomedov showed him incredible respect. After Song Yadong brutally knocked out Umar inside the Octagon, Khabib remained calm and humble. When Khabib approached Song, he even gave him a tissue and wiped the blood from his face. And Song Yadong showed the same level of respect toward the Dagestan team. Despite being ignored by Umar, Song still lowered his head and showed respect to Khabib and his team. A powerful reminder that true martial arts respect goes beyond winning or losing. 🥋🔥 Watch until the end to see this incredible moment between Song Yadong and Khabib Nurmagomedov. #songyadong #khabibnurmagomedov #umarnurmagomedov #UFC #ufcshanghai

videos.description: 🔥 "27-0 and 11 years undefeated. But they still doubted him." 🔥 Khabib Nurmagomedov made it clear before stepping into the octagon: "I just wanna smush people. This is what I wanna do. Doesn't matter... Dustin, Tony, or other opponents... When I go to the cage, I smush my opponents. All my life. 27 and 0. People talk about his six-win streak, what about 27-win streak? And 11 years undefeated! I don't wanna underestimate this guy, I know he's a tough challenge... but this guy is not on my level." 🦅💥 He didn't just talk the talk—he proved every single word inside the cage with relentless dominance. Undefeated. Unmatched. Pure legacy. 💯👑 #khabibnurmagomedov  #UFC #MMA  #undefeated #khabib
